display.title: European Central Bank Data Portal SDMX API
display.summary: Query the European Central Bank's public SDMX 2.1 statistical data, structural metadata, and structure-specific XML schemas, including complete path variants, content negotiation, and 12 searchable schemas.

documentation.stabilityNote: A complete anonymous read-only SDMX 2.1 REST contract independently reconstructed from current official ECB help pages. Hub does not proxy requests or responses; the SDK and CLI call the ECB public HTTPS service directly.

pricing.summary: The ECB API help pages do not publish a separate per-call price. The anonymous read-only service in this collection requires no API key; use and reuse remain subject to the ECB website information reuse terms.
